_doc: Lane fractions measured in-game or stated by John. Key = internal-variant id prefix (matches every variant whose Id starts with it). lane_fraction = share of ONE belt lane a single building keeps up with; per_lane = ceil(1/lane_fraction). Anything not listed here and not derivable from the wiki is an open question for John (tools/rates.py --full lists them).

Space belt lane = 4 belts (wiki). Our bus rule is 12 belt lanes per platform notch = one space-belt input. Confirm one space belt = 12 lanes x 4 = 48 belt-lanes at full, i.e. the 4x scale factor.
